title: Proper scalar comparison is invertible on bounded etale-origin inputs
statement: Let $p:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $A\to B$ be a map of finite commutative rings. Use ordinary unbounded constant-ring module derived categories on the etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let $E_e\in D^+(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and assume $H_e=E_e\otimes_A^LB_{Z,\mathrm{et}}$ also lies in $D^+(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. Put $E=\nu_Z^*E_e$ with the canonical comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Write $S=-\otimes_A^LB$ and use the B-linear counit mate $\chi_{p,E}:S_YRp_*^AE\to Rp_*^BS_ZE$ of [lem-fix-proetale-scalar-mate-normalization]. Then $\chi_{p,E}$ is an isomorphism in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$. More precisely, under the scalar-restriction identifications of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], its scalar restriction is $\nu_Y^*$ of the actual etale projection arrow $Rp_*E_e\otimes_A^LB_{Y}\to Rp_*(E_e\otimes_A^LB_{Z})$ of [def-kun-projection-formula-map], conjugated by the canonical tensor comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and the counit-mate direct-image comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] at $E_e$ and $H_e$ (p is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, being proper). No flatness or finite projective dimension of B over A is assumed.
